definitions: weave：编织；织成。woven 表示“编织成的、织成的”。

examples.text: What he is wearing, though, is still notable: a green Kiri tunic which seems to have been woven out of some kind of plant fiber like reeds or grass.
examples.explanation: 这里 woven 是 weave 的过去分词，woven out of plant fiber 表示“用植物纤维编织而成”。

source.text: Ocarina of Time Remake Trailer Analysis

examples.text: The trailer begins with a tapestry, a kind of woven textile art.
examples.explanation: 这里 woven 修饰 textile art，意思是“编织成的纺织艺术”；woven 是 weave 的过去分词形式。

source.text: Ocarina of Time Remake Trailer Analysis
